explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1150 (Littlewood flatness), negated in line with the cited OpenAI disproof [OAI26a], which has a linked Lean proof. The negated claim is that there is c > 0 such that for all large n every degree-n polynomial with coefficients ±1 has max_{|z|=1} |P(z)| > (1+c)√n. The supremum over the unit circle is of a continuous function on a compact set, so the real iSup is the genuine maximum. My cached copy of the page predates the disproof, so I could not cross-check the resolution there, but the statement itself is faithful.
